repository_commit_meaning: The commit the SOURCE registry is pinned to, and the only thing this field has ever meant anywhere in the corpus: `sources/source-registry.json.repository_commit`, `exports/manifest.json.repository_commit` and every `as_is` anchor's `location.commit` all carry this same value. It is foxBMS 2 v1.11.0, dated 2026-04-20, and `git merge-base --is-ancestor 308028fb13d046ba29b98886895c2e17937b1437 HEAD` returns true, so the pinned source really is an ancestor of the tree this corpus was authored in. It is NOT the commit the corpus content was authored at; see `corpus_authored_at_commit` below. The distinction matters because an `as_is` record cites a blob at THIS commit while every corpus judgement about it was made 18 months later against a working tree at HEAD.
corpus_authored_at_commit_meaning: The commit the corpus working tree was authored on top of: `git log -1` at the time of writing, 'fix: remove C:/ti paths, correct the SYS enum, replace a dead CMock counter', committed 2026-10-01T01:03:14+02:00. 74 commits touch docs/artifacts; the most recent commit under docs/artifacts/corpus is 1a2d898e9db9b7c8c7b3cd92e97f1749b8eb0028 (2026-09-30). Every number in every report in docs/artifacts/reports/ was measured against this tree, not against 308028fb13d046ba29b98886895c2e17937b1437. The two values are deliberately kept in two fields so that neither is read as the other: the corpus content does NOT exist at 308028fb13d046ba29b98886895c2e17937b1437, and the pinned source at 308028fb13d046ba29b98886895c2e17937b1437 contains none of it (`git ls-tree -r 308028fb13d046ba29b98886895c2e17937b1437` has no docs/artifacts entry).
